claim.summary: Over F2 with all Boolean generators, R_(m,n) has A:m by n,B:n by m,AB+I_m,m>n>=1. For square U,V:n by n,H=UV+I_n,E=VU+I_n, counter T_(n,i,j) retains H,all fields,Gij=1+Eij. A size-S depth-d general or Hilbert-like IPS certificate of R_(n+1,n), actual formal jointdegree D, gives one for every T_(n,i,j) with O(S+n²) size,depth<=d+4,jointdegree<=3D. Use Atilde=[U;row_i E],Btilde=[V,col_j E], full generator and field witnesses. Conversely T_(m,1,1) projects to every R_(m,n),m>n, without size/depth/jointdegree increase: Ubar=[0|A|0],Vbar=[0;B;0], H->F,G11=(VU)11->0; placeholders map to matching original labels or0. Polynomial-size fixed-depth existence for one-surplus rank and fixed-diagonal counter families is equivalent for general IPS and Hilbert-like IPS separately, with index shift in the projection. For a Hilbert-like counter C11=C0+cW in the same inner dimension n, D11=E11 C0+c K_E11 specializes to E11 from H+fields. Binary permutations/shears UQ,Q^-1 V retain H and transport linear field witnesses to derive all Eij consequences. This gives every R_(m,n) a Hilbert-like certificate of size O(n²S+n³),depth<=d+10,jointdegree<=D+4 (d+8 from a supplied full counter collection). Full Boolean-placeholder residual correction for P=product_(r,s)(1+F_rs) has size O(n²S+n³+m^4+m²n),depth<=d+16 (d+14 for full collection),jointdegree<=D+4+2m². Starting with Hilbert-like T_m projection instead gives O(S+m^4+m²n),d+6,D+2m². No reverse transfer from R_(2n,n) alone, new CNF theorem, PC-degree claim, all-certificate hardness or goal advance. Equation families are polynomial-description, fixed independently of proof exponent.

claim.summary: For fixed prime p, input circuits F_i over F_p of total size s/depth Delta, and Boolean B_j=x_j^2-x_j, put A=product_i(1-F_i^(p-1)). A general IPS certificate of size S/depth d yields a circuit Q(x,Z), linear in Z, with Q(x,0)=0 and Q(x,B)=A, at polynomial size in S+s+n+m and depth O(d+Delta+1). Conversely Q yields a full certificate with input coefficients F_i^(p-2) product_(l<i)(1-F_l^(p-1)). The forward proof explicitly linearizes general IPS by gate telescoping and constructs small Frobenius Boolean-defect certificates. No PC-degree, multilinearity-in-x or extension-field preservation is claimed.
